brief: A recipe manager as a transformation timeline — ingredients flow through steps and combine into the dish

dominant_strengths: Clear two-column flow with timeline rail communicates ingredient→transformation metaphor legibly and supports the brief's core concept
Warm beige process cards vs cool blue ingredient cards creates a meaningful semantic color split, not just decoration
Typography hierarchy is calm and confident: numbered step badges, bold step titles, muted time labels read at a glance
dominant_weaknesses: Emoji icons (🔥🌿) inside otherwise refined process cards feel cheap and break the editorial restraint of the rest
Arrows are static stubs; for a 'flow' brief, no convergence or merging is shown—ingredients don't visually combine into the dish
Right column floats disconnected from the timeline rail, weakening the spine metaphor and leaving large empty gutters
fix_priorities: Replace emoji with custom monoline icons or typographic glyphs to match the muted palette
Design real convergence: multiple ingredient lines merging into each transformation node, ending in a final 'dish' node
Tighten right-column alignment to the timeline and add subtle connective tissue (dotted joins, gradient flow lines)
Introduce a terminal step showing the finished dish so the timeline resolves rather than trailing off
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective concept (cooking-as-transformation) leads, behavioral clarity is solid, but visceral delight is dampened by emoji and an unresolved flow.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially solves the brief—structure evokes a timeline, but ingredients never visibly combine into a final dish, so the 'transformation' promise is incomplete.
